GROUP -by- EVENT TYPE interactions

value: Group-by-event-type interactions were observed in the bilateral putamen and left BA32 in SVC analyses. Activity in the putamen was lower in cocaine-dependent versus healthy control subjects for UCS and PTDE events and did not vary as a function of event type in cocaine-dependent individuals. In left BA32, PTDE-related activity was also lower in cocaine-dependent individuals. Whole-brain analyses suggested interactions in the bilateral insula, right precentral gyrus, left postcentral gyrus, left medial frontal gyrus/BA32, and left putamen; PTDE-related activity was lower in cocaine-dependent versus healthy control subjects, whereas NTDE-related activity was greater in cocaine-dependent subjects in the right precentral gyrus, left postcentral gyrus, and left insula.

TDE/Juice Paradigm

description.value: Participants learned to associate a visual cue with juice reward. During scanning, trials included normal expected juice delivery, omission of expected juice producing negative temporal difference errors, and unexpected delayed juice delivery producing positive temporal difference errors.

spans.text: During scanning the paradigm consisted of trials mimicking learning trials interspersed with trials in which juice was not received as predicted but instead received 4–7 s later, ie ‘catch' trials
